extraction_notes: report_status/report_reason are mirrored from data/snapshots/injuries-2026-11-17-1030am.json by (report_block, report_name) join at build time and re-verified against it row for row; they are the report's printed cells, not this file's observations.

Verbatim rule: a player with a game in the window appears either with a printed stat line (MIN/PTS/REB/AST as printed strings; REB is the printed TOT column, AST the printed A column) or with the printed designation (Inactive list entry, DNP - Coach's Decision, DND - ...). No value was computed or inferred.
Every row cites its own gamebook URL in source_url; game_id values are the ones recorded in data/snapshots/results-2026-11-15.json from the official game pages.

Name matching between the report's 'Last, First' print and the gamebook's 'First Last' print is by exact name tokens; suffixes (Jr., II) are kept as printed on both sides. Spelling variances surfaced and are kept: Nurkić/Nurkic (SP-02), Niederhäuser/Niederhauser (SP-03), Schröder/Schroder (SP-04).

The two rows whose team cell was lost at a page break keep a blank team in the injury snapshot; only the game-log row's team attribution comes from the gamebook's own inactive list, flagged as such. The 'Soreness' page-break fragment is not a player row and carries no game log.

Walker Kessler's row is a dated observation pair, not an inference: the official gamebook shows him playing 32:26 at Phoenix on 2026-11-15, and the official 11/17 report then lists him Out (Right Lower Leg). No availability probability or minutes projection is derived from the pair.

Each gamebook's SCORE BY PERIOD was cross-checked against data/snapshots/results-2026-11-15.json: all four games agree period for period (NYK 23/24/20/28/17 - TOR 17/26/31/21/13; SAS 31/27/23/29 - UTA 33/22/26/21; CHA 21/31/31/22 - LAC 22/29/33/29; LAL 33/31/40/27 - PHX 24/30/26/43).
